title: Extortion emails in practice
intro: "I hacked your camera" emails are a bluff. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Your password: Gunes2019. You have 48 hours
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Your password: Gunes2019. You have 48 hours
body: I got into your device and recorded private videos with your camera.
If you do not want the videos published, send bitcoin worth 1,500 AZN to: bc1q000000000000000000000000000000demo

decisions.explain: The security team can remove the same email from other colleagues' mailboxes too.

decisions.title: IshPocht: Your password: Gunes2019. You have 48 hours

artifact.title: IshPocht: Your password: Gunes2019. You have 48 hours
body: I have videos recorded with your camera. Send bitcoin or everyone will see them.

options.label: Copy the bitcoin address and pay

decisions.explain: Reporting without paying or replying is the best first step.

decisions.title: Do you see the photo of your house?
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Do you see the photo of your house?
body: This is your house. I know your address and your password.
Send 1,500 AZN in bitcoin, or the videos will be published.

decisions.explain: The house photo comes from a public map, so this is a mass bluff too.

decisions.title: Subut_video.zip
decisions.prompt: A reply came: supposedly proof. What do you do with this file?
decisions.explain: Do not open the file, and report the email to the security team.

decisions.title: Warning: extortion emails
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Warning: extortion emails
body: Today some colleagues received extortion emails showing an old password.
Do not pay and do not reply. Send the email with the Report button.
If you still use that password, change it.

decisions.explain: This email asks for nothing, it only repeats the right rules.
